name: The Defense of Grom'gol
summary: At Grom'gol, Commander Aggro'gosh moves to guard the supply road to Stonard. After the raptor hunt outside camp, Mosh'Ogg ogres at Mizjah Ruins keep attacking the caravans.

sections.title: Securing the Caravans
sections.body: Commander Aggro'gosh must keep supplies moving from Grom'gol through Stranglethorn Vale to Stonard, an outpost vital to the Horde. He did not come to fight every people of the Vale. Yet the Mosh'Ogg ogres have taken Mizjah Ruins southeast of camp, and warnings have not stopped their repeated attacks on Horde caravans. So Aggro'gosh orders a strike against the ogres and witch doctors holding the ruins.

faq.answer: The ogres occupy Mizjah Ruins, southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why is Grom'gol targeting these ogres?
faq.answer: Grom'gol sends supplies to Stonard. The ogres at Mizjah Ruins keep ambushing the caravans despite formal warnings to stop.
Commander Aggro'gosh, Grom'gol Base Camp's military leader, directs the strike against the ogres.
Before this request, Aggro'gosh ordered a hunt to thin the raptors outside Grom'gol.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know the caravans between Grom'gol and Stonard sustain the Horde's presence in the southern Eastern Kingdoms.
